why: omp model/provider registration; docs at github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/main/docs/models.md and docs/providers.md

model_registration.profile_paths: Named profiles: ~/.omp/profiles/<name>/agent/; PI_CONFIG_DIR changes config-root dir name; PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR overrides default-profile agent directory
model_registration.legacy: If both YAML files missing and models.json exists, it is migrated to models.yml
model_registration.root_shape: providers is the only root key the registry consumes; unknown root keys do not configure model behavior

provider_fields.baseUrl: string, required for full custom provider
provider_fields.apiKey: env-var-name-or-literal; prefix ! runs shell command, trimmed stdout used; required unless auth: none|oauth
provider_fields.api: one of openai-completions, openai-responses, openai-codex-responses, azure-openai-responses, anthropic-messages, bedrock-converse-stream, google-generative-ai, google-gemini-cli, google-vertex, typesafe, openrouter-decisions, openai-decisions, workers-ai-systemone
provider_fields.authHeader: true injects Authorization: Bearer <key> on every request
provider_fields.headers: per-provider extra headers; values may be !command secrets
provider_fields.disableStrictTools: true for Anthropic-compatible endpoints rejecting the strict field
provider_fields.discovery: type: ollama|llama.cpp|lm-studio|openai-models-list|proxy|litellm|apple-foundation-models; optional timeoutMs (positive finite); requires provider-level api except type proxy
provider_fields.models: list of custom models; each entry: id (required), name, api, reasoning, input, contextWindow, maxContextWindow, maxTokens, cost, headers, compat, baseUrl, tokenizer

model_entry_key_fields: contextWindow (positive, required for custom entries when provided)

validation_rules.full_custom_provider: baseUrl + apiKey (unless auth none/oauth) + api at provider level or per model
validation_rules.override_only_provider: must define at least one of: baseUrl, apiKey, auth none, headers, compat, disableStrictTools true, guardrailIdentifier, requestMetadata, non-empty modelOverrides, discovery, remoteCompaction

example_for_nexgate_bielik.yaml:
providers:
  nexgate:
    baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1
    api: openai-completions
    apiKey: NEXGATE_MASTER_KEY
    models:
      - id: coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b
        name: Bielik Minitron 7B (coopforge)
        contextWindow: 32768
        maxTokens: 8192
        cost: {input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0}
example_for_nexgate_bielik.notes: apiKey resolves as env-var-name first (exact case, non-empty), else literal string

credential_precedence: 2. models.yml config apiKey (beats stored OAuth deliberately, honored for custom baseUrl/gateway)
7. Other stored API key (broker-migrated, last resort)
model_registration.tool_support_declaration: models.yml has no explicit 'tools: true' flag; tool capability comes from the chosen api transport (openai-completions/openai-responses carry the tools param) plus per-model compat block; LiteLLM-served models declare supports_function_calling on the gateway side and drop_params on the route removes unsupported params
model_registration.discovery_options_relevant: discovery.type: litellm or openai-models-list (injectV1: false for versioned gateway roots) can auto-list gateway models; discovery requires provider-level api except proxy type
model_registration.transport_note: transport: pi-native sends every model under provider to omp auth-gateway via POST /v1/pi/stream; apiKey is the gateway bearer

flags_and_budget.model_selection: Select as provider/model-id, e.g. nexgate/coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b; --model flag or /model in session; modelRoles/enabledModels/enabledProviders/modelProviderOrder/cycleOrder live in model settings (packages/coding-agent/src/config/model-settings.ts)
flags_and_budget.disabling_providers: disabledProviders in ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or <project>/.omp/config.yml removes every model under that provider; checked before credentials
flags_and_budget.local_engines: ollama (OLLAMA_BASE_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:11434, keyless, implicit models use openai-responses), llama.cpp (LLAMA_CPP_BASE_URL, :8080), lm-studio (LM_STUDIO_BASE_URL, :1234/v1, openai-completions); implicit discovery skipped when same-ID provider exists in models.yml or is disabled
flags_and_budget.prompt_plus_tools_budget: Design target from outline: system prompt + tool schemas <= ~3k tokens (draft 3080B ~= 770 tokens); omp clamps locally by contextWindow/maxTokens from models.yml; no built-in hard budget flag documented in models.md/providers.md — budget enforced by operator via narrow --tools set and short system prompt
flags_and_budget.restart_after_config_change: Config loads at startup; omp models refresh <provider> refreshes discovery-backed catalog online

tool_calling_support: Covered by sibling item Tool_calling_transport.json (transport chain omp->LiteLLM->vLLM hermes parser / Ollama native tools); for omp itself: no explicit tools flag in models.yml — capability follows from api transport choice
context_and_limits: omp-side limits set in models.yml entry: contextWindow 32768, maxTokens 8192 for coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b (must match gateway model_info); quantization/VRAM are backend-side, see LiteLLM_gateway_NexGate.json
litellm_route: See LiteLLM_gateway_NexGate.json for the model_list entry; omp consumes it via provider nexgate baseUrl http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1
backend_serving: See LiteLLM_gateway_NexGate.json backend_serving (vLLM --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes vs Ollama native tools)
tool_call_rate: See Tool_calling_transport.json (curl gate 20/20=100%, suite v1 33% / v2 16%)
reasoning_core_gate: See Tool_calling_transport sibling item coverage in outline (item 'reasoning-core gate (omp)': rc init --host omp, native-precommit.patch + host-precommit.patch, omp_bridge.py, doctor 0/4 runtime unverified); gate extension code in openbao/.omp/extensions/reasoning_core_gate.ts blocks edit/read/grep/glob/find tool calls unless nativeEditProtocol===1 (qualified native precommit build) and refuses user_bash/user_python plus subagent spawns
pass_criteria: See Tool_calling_transport.json pass_criteria (>=80% suite target vs 16-33% actual, failure classes timeout/no-tool-call/hallucination)
uncertain: exact omp CLI flags (--tools/--system-prompt/--no-skills spelling) not present in models.md/providers.md excerpts read; verify against omp --help or docs/cli.md [uncertain]
whether omp applies an internal tools-token budget automatically [uncertain]
